batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b SR Watson

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c SK Warne b AD Mascarenhas

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c M Rawat b AD Mascarenhas

batting.name: MF Maharoof
batting.dismissal: c NK Patel b SR Watson

batting.name: GC Smith
batting.dismissal: c VY Mahesh b A Mishra

balls.text: digs in a short one, he pulls to the on side and thinks of a second run but they settle for a single
goes for a mighty heave but fails to make contact with the bat as the ball hits him flush on the body
swings and misses, they steal a bye
Watson bowls a low full toss and Maharoof stepsn down the track and slices it over the infield, the timing was good but not the placement as Niraj Patel takes the catch at sweeper cover
Maharoof steps down the track again and gets another short ball, he goes for a mighty heave and gets a thick top edge which clears the keeper
Watson bangs it in short on seeing Dilshan advance, he gets a thick under edge which just beats the keeper
steps down and clubs another full toss over deep midwicjet this time, 27 runs off this over!
a high full toss, he steps down and lofts that high over cow corner, quite an expensive over so far
makes room and scoops this one over backward point

a brilliant catch goes in vain! Maharoof steps down the track and carts it towards long-on, Kaif runs across and pulls off a blinder one handed but lands on the rope, if only the boundary was pushed back a little further....
one-handed! Warne bowls the flipper but it's too short, Maharoof steps forward and clubs it, releases his right hand on the follow through and the ball just clears long-off
full outside off, he leans forward and drives to deep cover
another slower one and another heave meets thin air
deceives him with the slower ball, he swings and misses
Maharoof goes for the pull but gets a thick top edge, the ball's in the air forever but just falls short of fine leg
full in length, he drives to the offside
cracker of a shot! The ball is short and kicks up on Dilshan who pulls and just clears the rope at long leg
bangs it in short of a length, he swivels and pulls over square leg
fires in a low full toss and Maharoof creams it past Munaf, Pathan runs across from long-off and cuts it off
and the boundary drought is broken - after 27 balls! Munaf overpitches and the ball swings away, he makes room and scoops this over backward point
full and swinging away from him, he digs it out to cover
holds the length back a touch, he pushes this through the line to long-off
fires in the yorker which seams away a touch, Maharoof watches it closely and digs it back to the bowler
full and swinging away from the right hander, he pushes it to mid-off
bowls the slower ball but misdirects it on the pads, he shuffles and nudges it off his pads to beat the keeper
another one bites the dust, Mishra makes room to scoop it through the line over long-off, Trivedi fires in the yorker and flattens the offstump
pitches on middle and leg, he shuffles and tucks it behind square on the on side
pushes a low full toss through the line to long-off
opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point, the batsmen hesitate and Dilshan is sent back, the throw was too high for Munaf to gather
slides on the pads and he flicks it quite fine, Pathan at the boundary slides and cuts it off
fires in another yorker, this one swings in and Dilshan fails to squeeze it out
fires in the yorker, he manages to dig it out but only back to the bowler
hits a good length on off and straightens, he defends back to the bowler
chops it down towards point and contemplates a single, sends him back
slides on the pads, he shuffles across and tucks it down to fine leg
fullish outside the offstump, he gets forward and drives through the line to deep cover

Mascaranhas signs off his bowling in the IPL in style! Pitches on the corridor outside off and straightens, Karthik pokes at it and gets a thin edge through to Rawat, Dimitri knows it and so does the umpire
opens the face of the bat again and steers it behind square on the offside
gives him width again outside the offstump, he opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man
tries a cheeky steer down to third man but misses

de Villiers stays at the crease and tries to loft him straight, he doesn't get to the pitch of the ball and gets a top edge which swirls in the air for ages, Warne runs across from cover and takes the catch in the region of mid-off
slides really wide down the leg side and they pick up an extra single off a deflection from Rawat
gets this one to nip back in and traps him on the pads, there was a thin inside edge onto his pads
bowls the flipper this time and the ball nearly goes through his legs as he makes room
pushes this one to deep midwicket
defended on the front foot to cover
gets across and whips it to deep midwicket
gets on his knee early and plays an imperious slog sweep, he gets his placement spot on and finds the gap at deep square leg
flighted on middle and leg, he tucks it to the onside
he gets forward and pushes this wide of the covers to retain the strike
he punches this off the meat of the bat and a sliding save at short cover cuts off at least another couple of runs
lunges forward and plays it through the line to mid-off
curves in from outside the offstump, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
slides on the pads and this one skids through to de Villiers as he tries to tuck it across the line, the ball rolls to the offside
he chips it on the up and just manages to clear short cover
flighted outside the offstump, he leans forward and pushes this one through the line to cover
tucks this one across the line to square leg
gives it a lot of air outside off, he drives on the front foot to cover
tucks it in front of square leg and they set off in a flash
whips a full delivery across the line and places it to square leg
pushes it wide of point, they scamper back for the second run
bowls a much quicker one, it sits up for Karthik as he defends to the offside
the slower ball does him in, Gambhir makes room to carve that over extra cover but fails to pick the offcutter as he under edges it onto the stumps, the offstump is flattened
gets across and tucks this one wide of midwicket
bangs in another bouncer but this one's a little quicker, it sails just over head height and the umpire deems it illegal
bangs in the short ball which is a little slow as well, he makes room and heaves it across the line to Watson at deep midwicket
slides on middle and leg, he shuffles and works it to the on side
fullish outside off, he places it towards mid-off
tapped to the on side for a single
steps down and heaves it across the line to the on side
gets forward to defend but the turn beats him
rocks back and punches with the turn to extra cover

risky run! He tucks it in front of square leg and there's plenty of hesitation in the running, a direct hit would have sent Gambhir back by miles, Warne couldn't get behind the wicket to gather the ball
flighted on middle and off, he leans forward and pushes it to the offside
slides on the pads, he tucks it down to fine leg

he times it well and sends the ball racing along the turf but a brilliant sliding save by Watson to his right at mid-off saves a certain boundary, Gambhir was ball watching but luckily the throw at his end was just wide
good slower ball, the offcutter nips back in and de Villiers defends it back to the bowler
this one nips back in off the seam, he shuffles across and tucks it behind square on the on side
the slower ball this time, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
gets a low full toss straight away and taps it down to long-on

Dhawan taps it a little wide of Munaf with soft hands and for some reason they set off for a single which was never there in the first place, Gambhir looks back but Dhawan decides to sacrifice his wicket and goes ahead with the run as Munaf gathers the ball and takes out the middle stump
the slower ball this time, he leans forward and taps it wide of point
Gambhir makes room to cut but gets a thin under edge which falls short of Rawat
pitches outside off, he leans forward and taps it in front of cover
grants him width outside off and he caresses it wide of backward point, Watson does well to run across from fine leg to intercept it
walks a couple of paces down the track and angles it wide of slip and takes off, Dhawan makes his ground before the direct hit

Watson pitches it outside off and the ball holds its line, Sehwag tries to punch it wide of the infield on the offside but ends up placing it straight to Kaif at backward point who hangs on to the sitter
he gets across his stumps early and tucks it very close to his pads, Watson appeals for a leg before, Sehwag runs the first very quickly and that allows them to scamper back for second, good running
brings the length a little fuller this time, he uses his wrists and works it away behind square on the on side
he pitches it short but it sits up nicely for Gambhir who makes room outside his leg stump and slaps it over cover
stays at the crease and plays a deliberate late cut down to third man
Sehwag sees the bouncer and goes for the hook, he's beaten for pace though
places it down to Kaif at point and sets off, they decide against the run initially but go ahead with it as Kaif has a shy at the stumps and misses
Munaf sees Gambhir advancing down the track and cleverly changes his pace, the ball rolls off Gambhir's pads to the offside
pitches on a good length outside off, he slices it wide of gully
he errs by pitching it on the pads and Sehwag gently glances it down to the vacant fine leg region, the margin for error is very little with this field
attempts to pull a short delivery but fails to cover the late inward movement, he nearly gloves it to Rawat
stands a little wide of legstump at time of delivery to give himself room, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
pitches on middle and leg and holds its line, he gets across and whips it behind square on the on side
slightly fuller in length, he gets behind the line and pushes it in front of Munaf at mid-off and sets off
Watson keeps it nice and tight by getting the ball to jag back in, the least Sehwag could do was to tap it to mid-on
Watson tempts him with width outside off and Sehwag has a whiff at it, he stays rooted to the crease and misses
bangs in the bouncer and he weaves away from the stroke, the umpire signals the one bouncer for the over
slides on the pads, he shuffles and whips it behind square on the on side
Now Gambir makes plenty of room rather early, takes a few paces forward and just creams that past Trivedi at mid-off, he had barely enough time to react
fullish outside off, he drives in front of square on the offside
slides way down the leg side and Sehwag can't resist chasing that, the ball appears to strike the back of the bat before rolling to square leg
this time Sehwag connects and it travels, he sees the width outside off and drags it wide of Trivedi at mid-on
he takes a pace forward and tries to whip it across the line but only manages an inside edge onto his pads
he throws his bat at a good length delivery which seams away, the ball sails past the vacant backward point region
he stays at the crease and chips it over square leg, deep square leg picks it up
nearly an edge? Or was it? Gambhir fishes outside off and there appeared to be a sound as it beat the bat, curiously both Rawat and Watson didn't appeal
pitches in line with the pads and Gambhir chips it over square leg, there's protection in the deep for him
he flirts outside off again and nearly gets a feather edge as he opens the face and tries to slice it down to third man
the first false shot from Gambhir as he chases a wide delivery and nearly gets a en edge to the keeper, Watson is amused by that
this one nips back in off the seam and cramps him for a bit of width outside off as he slices it wide of gully
he tries to tuck this through the on side but gets a thin edge onto his pads, Watson lets out a stifled appeal
full and wide outside off, he makes plenty of room but chops the ball down to the offside
he overpitches on the pads and Gambhir plays his trademark loft through the line while showing the full face of the bat and clears midwicket
Sehwag goes for broke over the on side but completely mistimes it as the leading edge falls short of extra cover
the slower ball this time, Sehwag slices it off the toe of the bat towards mid-off, he needs a replacement bat
pitches it full outside off and Gambhir leans onto the drive and forces it through the arc between mid-off and cover, Trivedi slides and cuts it off
and Mascarenhas nearly celebrates with a wicket! He pitches it on middle and gets it to cut back in, Gambhir gets a thin inside edge which nearly shaves the legstump ad the ball rolls to fine leg
Yomahesh bowls a low full toss outside off, Rawat stretches out and gets a thin outside edge which just beats Karthik
lovely shot! That eases the pressure for Rajasthan as Niraj leans forward and pounds a half volley past mid-off and cover
low full toss, he creams this towards extra cover and de Villiers fumbles
makes room and cuts this one straight to point
tries to punch it through the offside and he misses

confusion! Patel gigs out a yorker top the off side and sets off for a risky run, Watson is sent back and he's miles out of his crease as the throw misses the stumps, they take a run anyway off the overthrow but Watson's really struggling to make his ground at the striker's end, the throw to Karthik is accurate and he whips off the bails. Now here's the drama - Delhi celebrate but umpire Steve Davis refuses to call for the third umpire, Delhi fielders are really peeved and Sehwag has a word with umpire Koertzen, Watson is also fuming about the situation, as if to suggest they get on with the game, finally the third umpire is called and gives Watson the marching orders.
Warne tries to go for broke and goes for a wild swing, the legcutter lands on middle, straightens and takes out the middle stump
bowls it short of a length and Warne pulls it over midwicket, Dhawan runs across and cuts it off
an attempted yorker turns into a low full toss and he pushes this to sweeper cover
Dropped: Warne takes the aerial route but fails to get the elevation, Dilshan who doesn't drop many spills the sitter at long-on
another slower one and Warne misses as he tries to mow it across the line, in fact he gets an edge onto his body
foxes him with the slower ball and this one just sails over the middle stump, Sangwan thought he had him
comes round the wicket this time, but he lands it too full and he pushes it firmly past the bowler
makes a bit of room to squeeze that through the offside but the ball was a little too full, he's beaten
slides on the pads, he whips it across the line and places it to Sehwag at midwicket
McGrath errs by giving him too much width, he takes advantage of the fact that there's no slip and the outside edge sails past the keeper and down to third man
pitches on a good length outside off, he gets across and taps it wide of mid-off
cramps him for room and keeps it tight, he stays back and defends
Warne tries to flay that away through the offside but is beaten, Karthik stands upto the stumps
Watson's party gets better and better as he steps down the track and lofts it with the turn over long-on
full on the pads, he drives it with the turn to long-on
and immediately means business as he steps forward and lofts this with the turn and clears midwicket
Sehwag cleverly cuts back on the pace and gives it plenty of air, Mascaranhas misses as he goes for the slog and the ball crashes onto leg and middle stump
stand and deliver, Mascarenhas stays at the crease, picks the flight and carts Sehwag over long-off, that was a powerful biff
flighted on middle and leg, he turns it wide of midwicket
flighted outside off, he pushes it down to the offside
loses his direction and sprays it wide down the legside
sees the flight, gives him the charge and just manages to clear long-off
lovely application there! The ball pitches outside off and comes on straight, he opens the face of the bat and glides it with control past short third man
chases a wide delivery which spins away, he fails to make contact with the slog sweep
gets on his knee and slog sweeps it down to Dhawan at deep midwicket
a misfield by Sehwag helps Watson bring up his fifty, his third of the tournament
gets forward to drive but can't beat the bowler
full on middle and leg, he pushes it down the ground to long-on
full on the pads, he creams it through the line to long-on
flighted on middle and leg, he pushes it towards midwicket
the ball turns back in, skids through and catches him on the pads, that was missing leg
flighted on middle and leg, he gets on his knee and sweeps behind square
fullish outside the offstump, he pushes it towards cover
he oversteps, Watson goes the slog and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads
gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler
beats Watson on the forward prod with a hint of turn, no too far from the edge
gives it a lot of flight outside off, he leans forward and drives to long-off
the googly! The ball pitches on middle and turns away slightly, Jadeja gets on his knee to sweep it square but plays too early as the ball strikes the offstump
Mishra floats it towards the pads and he tucks it with the line to fine leg
hits a fullish length outside off, he leans forward and pushes it towards the covers
pushed it to the on side, they take an extra run off the overthrow
slides on the pads, he nudges it off the pads and tucks it to the on side
good comeback by Maharoof as he fires in the yorker and Jadeja squeezes it out back to the bowler
slides really wide down the leg side, Maharoof struggling a little here
Maharoof loses his line and slides on the pads, he tucks it away easily and picks the gap at fine leg
hits a fullish length outside off, he gets forward and defends
Jadeja swings across the line and gets a streaky under edge which just rolls pas the stumps and trickles to fine leg
gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler

catch of the tournament? Mishra flights it on middle and leg, Smith goes for the slog with the turn but doesn't get enough elevation to clear the boundary near deep midwicket, Yomahesh runs across from long-on and catches it just inches from the turf, that was simply stunning
gets on his knee and slogs this one along the turf past midwicket, two fielders converge but Gambhir just lets it slip out of his grasp and the ball rolls to the rope
steps forward and pushes it firmly back to the bowler, Mishra nearly flings the ball back
flighted on middle and leg, he stays at the crease and lofts over midwicket
another overpitched delivery gets pummeled as Watson stays at the crease, meets the pitch of the ball and deposits the ball over long-on
Smith isn't afraid to make room again as he pushes this through the line to long-off
makes room and pushes a full delivery down the ground wide of long-off
bangs it in short of a length towards the body and you're asking for trouble if Smith;s batting, he swivels and pounds it over midwicket
he over pitches on the pads again this time and he flicks it to deep square leg, that looked like heading the boundary
bowls a low full toss on the pads, he tucks it behind square to Dhawan at the deep
timing! He over pitches on the pads and Watson whips it with ease off the meat of the bat and the ball races through the turf down to deep midwicket
well bowled! He jams in the yorker and keeps Watson quiet as he digs it out back to the bowler
comes round the wicket this time, Watson leans forward and steers it just wide of cover and picks up a couple
Dropped: Watson goes for a short arm pull off a delivery which is fractionally short, Sehwag spills the catch low to his right at midwicket
Free Hit: Watson moves quickly across his stumps and attempts a cheeky paddle but he m misses, Karthik fumbles
Free Hit: And Yomahesh oversteps again! He bowls the quick yorker and Watson fails to put it away as he chases it outside off
he oversteps! Bowls that too full outside off and Watson creams it past the bowler and sends the ball scorching to the long-off boundary
overpitched outside the offstump, Watson stays at the crease and lofts it high, he just gets enough elevation to clear long-off
gets across his stumps and taps it softly towards cover and sets off
gives him a bit of width and it seams away, he follows the movement and steers it down to third man
fullish on middle and leg, he gets forward and pushes it towards mid-on

attempts to slap this one away to the on side and gets a thin edge onto his pad, the ball trickles close to the stumps but Smith was off the blocks quickly, he makes it before Sangwan can gather the ball
steps down the track to a short of a length delivery and slaps it towards mid-off and sets off for a quick single
Sangwan bangs it in too short, Smith gets on top of the bounce and pulls off the meat of the bat on the swivel, the ball rockets to deep square leg
take that! Yomahesh overpitches outside off and Watson drags it out and clubs it high over midwicket
shuffles across just a touch and meets the ball on the pads just outside the line of legstump, Yomahesh appeals confidently
on the roof! He pitches it a little to short and Watsonn reads the length early and swivels and clubs it over deep square leg, the bat speed was mighty quick and the ball was on the roof in no time
bangs it in short and gets the ball to rear up, he goes on the backfoot and defends
rocks back and shapes to defend but gets an inside edge
taps it down in front of cover and sets off, they take a chance with de Villiers who runs forward and attempts an under arm flick at the stumps
yorker, but it's going down leg and it flicks Smith's pad down to fine-leg boundary
shorter delivery, Smith jumps out of the crease and doesn't get to the length of the ball, drives straight to cover
pitched on middle and flicked to fine leg
pitched on off and moves away ever so slightly, Watson looks to drive and is beaten
pitched on off and moving away, Watson shoulders arms
pitched on off and driven to mid-off

Unbelievable! Smith pulled to midwicket where it was collected quickly by Sehwag. But Smith was already running down the track while Kaif was still standing at the other end. Easy run-out as Sehwag lobs the ball to the keeper
steps away from the stumps, McGrath adjusts and bowls a yorker which Smith digs out in the last minute
pitched to middle and off, flicked to square leg
pitched on off and comes in a touch, Kaif defends
pitched on off, Kaif leans forward and drives to cover
pitches on off and swings away
fuller ball, tapped to point
goes down leg side, ball stays low this time
hits the deck hard and pitches on off and moves away slightly, Smith pulls his bat away just in time
pitched on leg and flicked to leg side
tries to drive and is beaten

stepped out of the crease and away from the stumps to play inside out, the ball just rolls down towards mid-off and AB de Villiers runs in and dives full length in the air to hit the stump before Yusuf to get back into the crease
pitches on middle and off and nips back in, he's trapped high on the pads, McGrath lets out a stifled appeal
he's cramped for room to slice that through the offside but he's beaten all ends up, the ball nearly shaves the offstump
gets forward to a good length ball and defends to the offside
makes a bit of room and pushes it past the bowler, mid-off slides and cuts it off
loses his line and slides down the leg side, Smith misses out to fetch a boundary
makes room and fails to control a loft over the infield on the offside but instead gets a thick leading edge which falls on the first bounce to sangwan at third man
waits at the crease and gently dabs a delivery pitching outside off down to third man
makes a bit of room to club a short of a length delivery but in the last moment changes his mind and ends up tapping it softly back to the bowler
slides on the pads this time and Pathan fails to capitalise on that as the ball skids through and trickles of his pads
hits a good length outside off, he reaches forward and taps it towards the cover
bowls the slower one and Pathan's mighty heave meets thin air
fuller and closer to the offstump, he lofts through the line but doesn't quite control the stroke, there's just enough elevation to clear mid-off who runs back
gets off to a poor start as he gives Pathan too much width outside off, he reaches out and cuts wide of backward point
lovely bowling, pitches on off and keeps it straight, Smith has no room to work with and ends up defending back to the bowler
hits a good length outside off and seams into the left hander, he safely lets it go
Dropped: The ball swings in and lands on a fullish length on the pads, Smith chips it on the up towards square leg and Mishra spills the catch while diving forward
gives him the charge early and heaves it across the line towards midwicket, the ball comes off the edge and the timing was missing
lands on the seam on a good length outside off and shapes away, Pathan lets it go
this one keeps just a little low, it was more of a warm-up delivery, Pathan flashes and the ball creeps under the bat
